content.text:
The robot found the red ball and is now resting next to it, facing it. In the last camera image the ball is centered right in front of its feet, about 20–30 cm away.

How it got there:
- **Getting around obstacles:** I walked forward through the room. A black case blocked the way, so I sidestepped to the right to get past it. It didn't fall or bump into anything.
- **Spotting the ball:** A 360° look showed the ball far to the left, near the TV stand. I turned toward it and walked about 2 m.
- **Finding it again:** The ball was out of view after that walk because I had misjudged the distance and walked past it. When I turned around, it was right at the robot's feet. One small turn centered it.
- **Finishing:** The robot said "I found the red ball" and then rested.

The battery is at 72% and charging.
